exposure: Transvaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (vNOTES) for adnexal procedures
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 18 patients undergoing transvaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (vNOTES) for adnexal procedures.
finding: vNOTES is a safe and desirable approach for adnexal procedures, presenting a reasonable alternative to conventional laparoscopy or vaginal surgery with minimal analgesia, short hospital stay, and no postoperative complications in the reported cases.
